name: Sipa Resources Limited
summary: Sipa Resources Limited operates as an exploration company. It explores for nickel, copper, gold, silver, zinc, lead, and other mineral deposits. The company holds interest in the Warralong project covering an area of 720 square kilometers; and the Wolfe Basin base metal projects which covers an area of 780 square kilometers located in Western Australia. It also holds interests in the Skeleton Rocks project with 4 tenements covering approximately 800 square kilometers located to the west of the Southern Cross greenstone belt in Western Australia. In addition, the company holds an agreement to acquire the Garden Gully project that covers an area of 207 square kilometers located in the Murchison district of Western Australia; and Murchison gold project, which covers an area of approximately 260 square kilometers situated in the Murchison area of Western Australia. Sipa Resources Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Subiaco, Australia.
